database_connection.billing_calendar: Monday 04:00 AM IST through Sunday (Cutoff: Monday 11:00 AM IST)

tier_1_daily_ledger.purpose: Powers Driver App live feed and daily pacing. Granular shift reconciliation.

tier_2_vehicle_weekly.purpose: 1-to-1 mirror of Excel sheet 'Uber + OLA Final Hisaab'. GPS dead miles, platform earnings, and TDS.

tier_3_partner_weekly.purpose: 1-to-1 mirror of Excel sheet 'Hisaab Summary'. Multi-car fleet consolidation and bank payouts.

system_configuration.purpose: Engine operational toggles, including enable_roll_forward and roll_forward_start_week.

opening_balances.purpose: Initial verified debt/credit balances for driver & partner mobile app go-live cutover.

core_formulas.sign_convention: Positive balance = Driver owes company (to_collect); Negative balance = Company owes driver (to_payout / net_bank_payout)
core_formulas.daily_net_balance: net_daily_rent + ABS(uber_cash + ola_cash + rapido_cash) - (uber_earnings + ola_net_revenue + rapido_net_revenue) - ola_online_payment + daily_challans + daily_accidents - daily_adjustments - sunday_milestone_incentive
core_formulas.vehicle_current_week_os: net_weekly_lease_rental + ABS(total_cash_collected) - total_platform_earnings - ola_online_payment - platform_incentives - adjustments + challans + accidents + dead_mile_charges + tds_amount

modular_roll_forward_modes.standalone_mode (current default): previous_outstanding = 0.00 across all cycles. Each weekly hisaab is independent without merging unverified historical collections.
modular_roll_forward_modes.app_opening_balance_cutover: Reads opening_balance_due from hisaab_partner_opening_balances for the go-live settlement cycle.
modular_roll_forward_modes.dynamic_roll_forward_mode: Activated via enable_roll_forward = 'true' in hisaab_system_config. Carries forward verified positive debt from previous cycle.

core_formulas.dead_mile_allowance: ideal_gps_km = (total_trip_km * 1.05) + (completed_trips * 3.0 km) + (onroad_days * 30.0 km). Penalty = GREATEST(0, total_gps_km - ideal_gps_km) * 3.00 INR (Individuals only, 0 for Operators)
core_formulas.tds_194c: 1% on (net_platform_earnings - net_weekly_lease_rental) for Individuals if earnings > rent. 0% for Operators.

key_operational_engines.modular_roll_forward_engine: Decouples current week hisaab from unverified previous dues via hisaab_system_config and hisaab_partner_opening_balances.
key_operational_engines.operational_trip_override: If a car is marked Maintenance/RFD or net_daily_rent <= 0, but completed trips > 0 or earnings > 0, system automatically bills standard contracted tariff from core_rent (fallback 856.00 INR).
key_operational_engines.multi_driver_deduplication: Operators only receive trips explicitly tagged with their code or untagged trips when no individual driver drove that day. Secondary drivers on the same car capture trip earnings with 0 rent to avoid double-charging lease rent.
key_operational_engines.prior_period_routing: Adjustments occurring in locked past weeks are intercepted BEFORE INSERT and routed to the current active cycle with is_prior_period = TRUE and effective_date = CURRENT_DATE. Polarity: DEBIT adds to dues, CREDIT reduces dues.
key_operational_engines.monday_lock_enforcement: Every Monday at 11:00 AM IST, sp_check_and_enforce_monday_lock freezes hisaab_settlement_weeks, hisaab_daily_ledger, hisaab_vehicle_weekly, and hisaab_partner_weekly. PostgreSQL trigger guards abort any subsequent updates.
